title: No new laser charge on the zone trip: while walking to the next circle or escaping the zone, the laser does not start a charge (ZONE_TRIP_NO_CHARGE_ON)
behaviors: while mode is 'to next circle' or 'zone escape' (t >= 10), the laser may not take the lead and start a new charge; gun and lightning lead and fire as usual; a charge already in progress is released by the champion's rules
next_action: Grok: assign or park. If built: one flag ZONE_TRIP_NO_CHARGE_ON default false, base-0 96-game hazard with fired / different behavior / different score, zone damage taken, deaths with zone travel in the last 5 s, drop-ring arrivals, pins, deaths < 40 s.
single_decision: Whether the laser may start a charge during zone travel. Protocol: while charging you move at half speed (protocol.md:305, charge_move_mult 0.5; sim engine.ts:421). Zone travel (brain.ts:750-759) leaves just in time (needed >= timeLeft with a 10 s buffer, brain.ts:546-551), but the target code (brain.ts:1028, :1079) still starts laser charges on the way, so the trip runs at half speed for each 0.75 s charge plus the time to line up the release.
trigger: ZONE_TRIP_NO_CHARGE_ON AND obs.t >= 10 AND mode is 'to next circle' or 'zone escape' AND the laser would take the lead (clear target, laser cooldown <= 0, d <= laser range, brain.ts:1028) AND its charge is 0 (a new charge would start at brain.ts:1079). Drop gate: by construction never on a drop tick (zone travel ranks above the drop run and the drop run requires !leaveNow && !trip && me.in_zone, brain.ts:730), and counted with the narrow gate as well.
hook: brain.ts act(), weapon lead choice brain.ts:1028: `if (clear && laser >= 0 && w(laser).cooldown <= 0 && d <= w(laser).stats.range)` gains `&& !(ZONE_TRIP_NO_CHARGE_ON && obs.t >= 10 && (mode === "to next circle" || mode === "zone escape") && (w(laser).charge ?? 0) <= 0)`, so lightning (brain.ts:1031) or the gun (:1034) leads instead. A charge already in progress keeps the laser in the lead and is released as today. Flag in params.ts.
gates: Cannot start before t = 10 s (explicit; zone travel cannot happen before the first shrink at 60 s anyway). Only in the two zone-travel modes, which rank above the drop run (brain.ts:750-759 vs :818-823), so it can never displace or alter a drop run or hold. No movement change: the path and the boost rule are the champion's; only the laser start is withheld. Off = champion exactly.
drop_gate: This is the clearest case of the drop-on-the-map trap: with the plain gate (obs.drops empty) it fires in 0/192 on both sets, because the first drop is called at 70 s, inside the first shrink (60-110 s), and called or untaken drops then stay listed for every later zone trip. The spec therefore does not use the plain gate. Zone travel already excludes a drop run or hold on the same tick (brain.ts:730). Counts with the narrow gate (no claimable drop within 200 m and no dropMove/dropHold) are 15/192 and 21/192. Plain gate = obs.drops is empty. Narrow gate = no drop with holder null or us within DROP_RUN_M (200 m), the same `dropNear` test P29 uses (brain.ts:852), and the champion's dropMove/dropHold are both off on that tick.

evidence.protocol: protocol.md:305: laser charge 0.75 s, move at half speed while charging, cooldown 1.65 s; release fires along the aim. Sim models it (/tmp/wild-sim/engine.ts:421).
evidence.sim_zone_deaths: P-D-007 Step A (PR #124, bot 6182d29): 'died after 60 s with zone travel in the last 5 s' in 28/192 and 37/192 games; zone travel yields almost no kills (15 kills in 6,520 travel ticks, 21 in 9,642). Run 1 on the P29 champion: zone travel in 21/24/29/28 games and deaths with travel in the last 5 s in 13/15/19/15 games (bases 2000/3000/4000/5000).
evidence.sim_zone_escape: Run 1: the champion is outside the circle ('zone escape') in 43/79/73/100 episodes over 9/8/13/11 games per base; outside it loses 20-260 HP/s with no armor and no regen (protocol.md:291, section 9).
evidence.sim_charge_cost: Run 2, narrow gate: the champion spends 326 decisions (32.6 s) charging the laser during zone travel in 17 games (2000+3000) and 697 decisions (69.7 s) in 22 games (4000+5000). 142 of 147 narrow-gated new charges are on 'to next circle', 5 on 'zone escape'.
evidence.watcher: movement_slices.csv: mean speed at alive_5_8 7.51 vs 4.22 m/s (d=0.61, 8475/7763 ticks, 72/68 matches, ok) and 7.54 vs 4.98 at alive_2_4 (d=0.46, ok); late phase 7.15 vs 5.31 and final 8.31 vs 5.73 (small n, no conclusion). Top teams keep moving late; zone.md has no in/out gap in adequate buckets (outside 0.3% vs 0.3%).
evidence.counter_evidence: P-D-010 (PR #140): healthy en-route travel delay changed zone arrival in only 6/192 and 2/192 games, so a slow trip rarely decides arrival on its own; this rule removes a delay that happens while a target is in view (when travel is most exposed), which P-D-010 did not isolate.

trigger_counts.note: Gated to <= 8 alive it would fire in 6/192 and 14/192 games (fails the first set), so it is not alive-gated. Run 3 recounted the starts on all four bases independently and got the same numbers.

estimated_activation: 19/192 and 31/192 games (narrow drop gate: 15 and 21); 61 and 154 withheld charge starts (38 and 109 with the narrow gate).
closest_prior_test: None on laser use during travel. Zone timing: P-D-007 Step B ZONE_EARLY_S failed in sim (zone-travel deaths 28->30, 37->45, PR #125), a different decision (when to leave). P-D-010 travel delay: measurement, no Step B. Laser handling: B32 laser pre-charge behind cover LOSS 3.48; P34 lethal release (when to let go) is in screening; this changes only whether a charge starts while travelling.
what_would_disprove: Paired screen: no fall in zone damage taken or in 'zone escape' time in fired games, or fewer kills/more deaths on zone trips (the lost laser shots mattered more than the speed); fires < 10/192; drop-ring set totals below the champion or deaths < 40 s above.
risks: Pins: none (no movement change). Drops: none (only in modes that rank above the drop run). Combat: a 315-damage laser shot is given up on each blocked start; against a lone chaser the gun's lower DPS may lose the exchange. Lightning holders keep the lightning. Sibling not included: run 3 shows the same half-speed charge during a hurt retreat in 64/192 games (narrow 59) on 2000+3000; that would be a separate flag in the retreat family and is not part of this spec.
